strategy_notes: Successful attempt 6 localized the target by first reading the initial image: the task bowl was the patterned black bowl next to the gray ramekin, not the lower bowl near the cookies box. Agentview identified the duplicate relation and the red-ring plate; manual back-project samples put the plate near [0.135,-0.035,0.912] and the ramekin near y≈0.17. Because agentview bowl depth samples were rim/table-biased, the eef was moved above the bowl/ramekin pair at [-0.19,0.245,1.12], then wrist pixels on the same relation target refined the target bowl to about [-0.203,0.335]. The winning command sequence was: move_to [-0.19,0.245,1.12] open; move_to [-0.203,0.335,1.12] open; pi0_pick prompt 'pick up the akita black bowl' with max_chunks 20, lift_thresh 0.05, gripper_closed_thresh 0.06; set_gripper +1 for 8 steps; carry with +1 to [-0.05,0.16,1.10]; carry with +1 to [0.10,0.02,1.08]; descend with +1 to [0.125,-0.005,1.03] then [0.125,-0.005,1.005]; release max_steps 30. The final low release fired termination.
